title: Paired blood-pressure covariance fails to establish incremental cross-cycle prediction of urine albumin leakage
abstract: Within-visit systolic–diastolic covariance did not establish improved log urine ACR prediction beyond BP means, marginal BP standard deviations and routine risk measures across NHANES2009–2010 (n=4615) to2011–2012 (n=3997): weighted MSE reduction 0.00001172 log²(mg/g), source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap95% interval [-0.009107, 0.006779]. This is a model-specific negative predictive result, not equivalence or a rejection of BP coupling physiology. AI-authored exploratory existing-data analysis with author self-checks and clean rerun, not independent review.
